title: Evidence-Grounded Content Studio
summary: A research and content production system that grounds generation in reviewed evidence, versions source sets and content, supports multi-channel adaptation, and requires approval before scheduling.
problem: AI content generation is unreliable when research, evidence selection, drafting, revision, and approval are collapsed into one prompt. A useful content workflow needs to preserve which sources were reviewed and prevent later edits from changing previously approved material invisibly.
system: Content requests move through web research or supplied sources, source review, evidence-backed planning, generation of multiple article options, evaluation and revision, channel adaptation, package approval, and an internal publishing queue.

engineeringDecisions.title: Reviewed evidence before writing
engineeringDecisions.detail: Source selection and conflict handling happen before substantive generation rather than relying on model memory.

engineeringDecisions.title: Version source sets and content
engineeringDecisions.detail: Later edits do not silently rewrite the evidence or content that a reviewer previously accepted.

engineeringDecisions.title: Keep channel adaptation downstream
engineeringDecisions.detail: LinkedIn, X, and newsletter variants are derived from a selected article and approved evidence base.

reliability.title: Grounded factual claims
reliability.detail: Substantive content is generated from the reviewed source set, with conflicting evidence surfaced for resolution.

reliability.title: Approval before scheduling
reliability.detail: Only approved article/channel packages become eligible for the internal scheduling queue.

reliability.title: Honest publishing boundary
reliability.detail: The system does not claim to publish directly to external social or email providers.

result: A content workflow that treats research provenance, evidence review, versioning, approval, and downstream channel adaptation as part of the product rather than wrapping a text generator in a form.

evidence.label: Source repository
evidence.description: Next.js application with research, generation, approval, scheduling, and test flows.

title: Operations Reporting & Decision Support
summary: An operations reporting system that combines automated KPI processing, persisted run data, data-quality visibility, and AI-assisted management interpretation across Sales, Project Delivery, and People Ops.
problem: Operational reporting becomes misleading when AI is allowed to invent or recalculate business metrics. The system needed a dependable way to compute KPIs, preserve the exact run, expose data-quality limitations, and still use AI where interpretation is valuable.
system: An n8n automation processes reporting data across Sales, Project Delivery, and People Ops, persists deterministic KPI results and quality issues in Supabase, and a Streamlit dashboard loads the exact run to present authoritative metrics alongside model-generated summaries, risks, and recommended actions.

nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.detail: Runs, metrics, AI insights, quality issues

engineeringDecisions.title: Keep KPI math deterministic
engineeringDecisions.detail: Business metrics are persisted by the automation and treated as authoritative; the dashboard does not silently recalculate them.

engineeringDecisions.title: Use AI for interpretation
engineeringDecisions.detail: Model output adds executive summaries, risks, and recommended actions without replacing the underlying calculations.

engineeringDecisions.title: Expose data quality
engineeringDecisions.detail: Limitations and issue registers are part of the report rather than hidden when source data is incomplete.

reliability.title: Partial-run usefulness
reliability.detail: Deterministic reporting remains available when the AI interpretation step is unavailable.

reliability.title: Exact-run dashboard loading
reliability.detail: The UI loads the report run returned by the workflow instead of showing whatever happens to be most recent.

reliability.title: Manual calculation evidence
reliability.detail: Separate KPI workbooks reproduce Sales, Project Delivery, and People Ops calculations for cross-checking.

result: A reporting system that separates factual operational measurement from probabilistic management interpretation while making data quality and calculation evidence visible.

evidence.label: Dashboard repository
evidence.description: Streamlit command center that triggers the automation and renders persisted report runs.

evidence.label: KPI calculation evidence
evidence.description: Manual calculation workbook verifies the Sales, Project Delivery, and People Ops KPI logic.
